source.rationale: P20, the _pos digit-in-entity guard. Execs 13045880 / 13206773: '4 smart delivery status' on a 4-member offer. _extract's loose arm - any bare-digit word in a <=4-word reply - read the '4' of the CUSTOMER NAME '4 SMART' as position 4 and confirmed an escalation to that member, i.e. a real staff assignment off a delivery question. The guard keeps that best-effort arm only when the LLM did NOT read the turn as a new business query: here domain_hint is 'order' and a current-message entity CONTAINS the digit token, so the digit is part of a name, not a position. Before the fix escalation.is_escalation_confirmation is true with preferred_assignee_id; after it the offer is abandoned as a new query and no escalation is confirmed. The strict arms (bare '4', '#4', 'option 4', '4th') and _forcePick are untouched - LESSON 39's wrong-assign guarantee stands.
